rapports.pageSubtitle: Every indicator that can be computed today from the network's real data — hover the ⓘ next to any information to see exactly what it tells you.

periodTooltips.today: Deliveries and leak tests since midnight today.
periodTooltips.7d: Deliveries and leak tests from the last 7 days.
periodTooltips.30d: Deliveries and leak tests from the last 30 days.
periodTooltips.90d: Deliveries and leak tests from the last 90 days.

activeStations.label: Active stations
activeStations.help: Number of stations in your network currently in service (active status). A gap with the "online" count points to stations whose sensor is no longer reporting.

networkStock.label: Total network stock
networkStock.help: Sum of the fuel physically present in every active tank, across all products, right now.

stockValue.label: Stock value
stockValue.help: Market value of the current stock, computed using each product's latest known price per station. If a station has no price defined, its value is excluded — the total may therefore be partial.
stockValue.partial: Partial calculation — some stations have no price defined

activeAlerts.label: Active alerts
activeAlerts.help: Total number of alerts currently unresolved across the whole network, of every type (high level, low level, water detected, leak, sensor offline).

atgAvailability.label: Telemetry availability
atgAvailability.help: Share of tanks whose sensor is currently reporting ("online" status). A value below 100% means some tanks no longer have reliable data — a hidden stock-out risk.

lowestStock.label: Station closest to running out
lowestStock.help: Among all active stations, the one with the lowest fill rate (stock/capacity) — the first one to watch for a delivery.

deliveredVolume.label: Volume delivered
deliveredVolume.help: Total volume received by the network over the selected period, automatically detected from a tank level rise (no declarative bill of lading in Zylo Liquid today).

leakTests.label: Leak tests
leakTests.help: Number of static leak tests run over the period (station at rest). An anomaly means a loss rate above the standard threshold (0.38 L/h).

alertBreakdown.title: Alerts by type
alertBreakdown.titleHelp: Breakdown of currently active alerts by type — shows at a glance which kind of issue dominates the network.

typeHelp.level_high: The fuel level has exceeded this tank's configured high threshold — overflow risk.
typeHelp.level_high_pre_alarm: The level is approaching the high threshold — an early warning before the full alarm.
typeHelp.level_low: The level has dropped below the configured low threshold — stock-out risk, a delivery is likely needed.
typeHelp.water: Water has been detected at the bottom of the tank beyond the configured threshold — fuel quality risk.
typeHelp.leak: A static leak test measured a loss rate above the standard threshold (0.38 L/h).
typeHelp.sensor_offline: This tank's sensor is no longer reporting — displayed data may be stale.

ranking.title: Station ranking
ranking.titleHelp: Every station in the network, compared on the same criteria. Click a column header to sort.

columns.fillRateHelp: Current volume divided by the station's total capacity, as a percentage. A low value signals a stock-out risk.
columns.alertsHelp: Number of unresolved alerts currently on this station, of every type.
columns.deliveredHelp: Total volume received by this station over the selected period, automatically detected from a tank level rise.
columns.availabilityHelp: Share of this station's tanks whose sensor is currently reporting — a low value signals a telemetry issue to fix.

leaks.title: Leak tests (period)
leaks.titleHelp: Results of static leak tests run over the selected period — a test compares the level at the start and end of a window, station at rest.
leaks.empty: No leak test recorded for this period.

columns.rateHelp: Volume lost per hour over the test window. Above 0.38 L/h (EPA standard), the test is classified as an anomaly.

caisse.pageSubtitle: Sales estimated from tank level drops, valued at the sale price in effect — never an official accounting record.
caisse.banner: Figure estimated from tank telemetry, excluding delivery windows. Click an amount to see its breakdown, down to the measurement that produced it.
caisse.incompletePricingBanner: {count, plural, one {# station has} other {# stations have}} sales whose revenue isn't fully calculable (missing price or mixed currencies) — configure sale prices to complete the calculation.
caisse.noData: No calibrated tank allows a cash calculation on this scope.
caisse.operationalDayToggle: Operating day (each station's own opening time)

dailySummary.title: Automatic summary (deterministic rules, not a human analysis)
dailySummary.attentionNeeded: {count} station(s) to watch (anomaly or insufficient data).

reasons.no_calibration_table: Tank not calibrated — volume not calculable.
reasons.no_applicable_price: No sale price configured for this period.
reasons.incomplete_pricing: Incomplete pricing on at least one contributing tank.
reasons.insufficient_data: No usable measurement for this period.

comingSoonPageSubtitle: This feature depends on data that Zylo Liquid Level 1 does not provide yet (tank telemetry only) — it will be enabled in a future phase.

configuration.pageSubtitle: Organization, prices, thresholds, products and system. Changes take effect immediately across the app.
configuration.comingSoonNotifications: The notification center is not yet available in Zylo Liquid.
configuration.comingSoonUtilisateurs: User and role management is currently done from Zylo Office — direct integration into Zylo Liquid is not yet available.

prices.banner: Administered price regime. Fuel sale prices are usually set by the regulator — it stays configurable here to keep history and value the stock.
prices.gridSubtitle: Network (by currency) → currency (stations concerned) → station (effective price and history). Click a currency or a station to see detail, click a price to edit it.
prices.showRawHistory: Show raw history (all stations and products)
prices.addSubtitle: Writes a new row to the price history — a correction never overwrites a real change.
prices.currencyAuto: Currency resolved automatically from the station's city ({code}).
prices.currencyUnresolved: This station has no resolvable currency (city not linked to a country) — pick one manually.
prices.networkDefaultHint: Applies to any station that has no price of its own for this product — a station with an existing price keeps its own.
prices.historySubtitle: Most recent rows, across all stations and products

bulk.title: Bulk pricing
bulk.description: Applies the same price to several stations in one action. Each station gets its own history row.
bulk.stations: {count, plural, one {# station selected} other {# stations selected}}
bulk.mixedCurrencies: The selected stations don't all share the same currency — a single price can't be applied. Narrow the selection.
bulk.noCurrency: {count, plural, one {This station has} other {These stations have}} no resolvable currency: {names}.
bulk.previewNew: {count, plural, one {# station will} other {# stations will}} receive this price for the first time.
bulk.previewExisting: {count, plural, one {# station already has} other {# stations already have}} a price for this product:
bulk.overwriteExisting: Also record a new row for these stations

grid.noProducts: No active product in the catalog.
grid.noCurrenciesHint: Record a first price (manual form below) to make a currency column appear.
grid.networkDefaultHint: Applies to any station operating in this currency that has no price of its own for this product.
grid.noStationsForCurrency: No station operates in this currency.
grid.currencyUnresolvedStation: This station has no resolvable currency (city not linked to a country) — its prices can't be edited here, use the manual form with an explicit currency.
grid.historySubtitle: Who, when, why — each row is an insertion, never a correction of an existing one.
grid.noHistory: No price recorded for this station.

fuelCatalog.banner: The catalog is shared across the whole network. A fuel product is never deleted — it is removed from the catalog, which preserves all history.
fuelCatalog.title: Products
fuelCatalog.name: Name
fuelCatalog.codeHint: The code is the product's database key: it cannot be changed.
fuelCatalog.colorReserved: This shade of red is reserved for system alerts — pick another color.
fuelCatalog.lastKnownPriceHint: Legacy field, not fed by the price history — see the Fuel prices tab for the actual current value.
fuelCatalog.addSubtitle: Writes a row to your organization's fuel reference data.

summary.geoMessage: {count, plural, one {# station has} other {# stations have}} no resolvable currency (city not linked to a country).
summary.sellPriceMessage: {count, plural, one {# station has} other {# stations have}} an active product with no sale price recorded.
summary.costPriceMessage: {count, plural, one {# station has} other {# stations have}} a sale price with no cost price — margin can't be calculated.

thresholds.banner: Real per-tank thresholds (in millimeters), identical to the ones configurable from the Tank page — consolidated, sortable and filterable view across the whole network.

organisation.name: Organization name
organisation.unavailableNote: Logo, main phone, main email, language, timezone and default currency are not settings available in Zylo Office yet — they are not shown here rather than displaying a field that saves nothing.

holykell.unavailableNote: Holykell connection credentials (login, password, device group) are not editable from this interface today — only the sync status is available read-only.

systeme.leakThresholdHint: EPA standard value — a drop above this rate over a stable period triggers a leak alert.
systeme.deliveryRiseThresholdHint: A rise above this value in a single reading triggers delivery detection.
systeme.deliveryStabilizationHint: Wait time after the rise to confirm the delivery has ended and compute its volume.
systeme.readOnlyNote: These values are system-wide constants, identical for the whole network — not yet configurable per organization.
systeme.unavailableNote: Disconnected sensor delay and delivery gap tolerance are not real settings in Zylo Liquid yet — they are not shown here rather than displaying invented values.

comingSoon.notifications: The notification center is not available in Zylo Liquid yet.
comingSoon.utilisateurs: User and role management is currently done from Zylo Office — direct integration in Zylo Liquid isn't available yet.

leaks.pageSubtitle: {count} static leak test(s) recorded — {anomalies} anomaly(ies) detected
leaks.banner: Static detection only (station at rest) — water and temperature correction applied before threshold (0.38 L/h, EPA standard).

deliveries.pageSubtitle: {count} delivery(ies) automatically detected by a tank level jump

detail.title: Delivery — {station}
detail.valueHint: Computed at the currently effective sale price — not the price on the day of the delivery (not kept in history).
detail.measurementsSubtitle: Every sensor reading between the start and end of the detected delivery
detail.measurementsEmpty: No measurement found in this period.

deliveries.empty: No delivery detected in this period.
deliveries.noStation: No station received a delivery in this period.

inProgress.title: {count, plural, one {# delivery in progress} other {# deliveries in progress}}
inProgress.subtitle: Level rise detected live, not yet stabilized — recomputed every 10 seconds, nothing is saved until the delivery is confirmed.

approvisionnementScreen.pageSubtitle: Deliveries declared by a human — distinct from automatically detected deliveries (see Deliveries).
approvisionnementScreen.banner: Each declaration can be reconciled on demand with a delivery detected by telemetry.

form.title: Declare a delivery
form.required: Station, product and volume are required.

shiftsScreen.pageSubtitle: Shift start/end and cash declared, per tank.
shiftsScreen.banner: Reconciled with the already-computed telemetric cash aggregate (see Daily cash) — never a new calculation.

form.title: Declare a shift
form.required: Tank, amount and currency are required.

pompisteDashboard.banner: This role has no piloting view (stations, tanks, network finance) — only your shift and your own declarations are visible, matching the validated pump attendant scope.

ventesScreen.pageSubtitle: Commercial qualification of an already-observed distribution — never a new independent fact.
ventesScreen.banner: A credit sale automatically opens a receivable on the selected commercial account (see Credit customers).

form.title: Record a sale
form.required: All fields are required (commercial account required for credit).

maintenanceScreen.pageSubtitle: Station equipment and interventions — planning, assignment, closure.

form.title: Add equipment
form.name: Name / tag
form.required: Station, type and name are required.

form.title: Report an intervention
form.required: Equipment, priority, type and description are required.

produitsScreen.pageSubtitle: Non-fuel product catalog and counter sale — entity kept separate from fuel sales (which qualify an already-observed distribution).

form.title: Add a product
form.name: Name
form.required: Name, price and currency are required.

sale.searchPlaceholder: Search a product or scan a barcode…
sale.creditAccountRequired: A commercial account is required for a credit sale.

reglementaireScreen.pageSubtitle: Regulatory documents and declarations by station — a certainty level is shown for each obligation, never presented as equally certain.
reglementaireScreen.banner: The precise detail of some Cameroonian regulatory obligations still needs confirmation (see the mission's business research). The principle of each obligation is retained; its exact detail may require professional verification.

form.title: Add a document
form.required: Station and document type are required.

creditScreen.pageSubtitle: Customer accounts, credit limit and open receivables.
creditScreen.banner: Exceeding the credit limit is blocked at the sale, never allowed silently.

form.title: Create a customer account
form.name: Name
form.required: Name, currency and limit are required.

reconciliationScreen.pageSubtitle: Declared sales compared to telemetric stock, tank by tank and day by day.
reconciliationScreen.banner: Directly reuses the already-computed cash aggregate (see Daily cash) — no new telemetric calculation.

caisseEcartsScreen.pageSubtitle: Discrepancies detected by reconciliation, across all types.
caisseEcartsScreen.banner: Read-only view — each row comes from a reconciliation already triggered elsewhere (Supply, Stock reconciliation, Tanks).

table.title: Tank summary table
table.subtitle: The chart is never alone: every value is also readable as plain text

dashboard.pageSubtitle: {stations} station(s), {tanks} tank(s), {products} product(s). Consolidated network view.

createModal.title: Add a station
createModal.name: Station name
createModal.nameHint: Name shown across the app (list, detail, reports)
createModal.codeHint: Short identifier, unique in your network (e.g. STA-01)
createModal.cityHint: Determines the station's native currency and timezone
createModal.resolvedCurrency: This station's currency: {code} (derived from the selected city's country)
createModal.currencyOverrideHint: Fill in only if this station bills in a different currency than its country (e.g. a border station). Leave empty to inherit automatically from the city.
createModal.addressHint: Physical address of the station, optional
createModal.coordinatesHint: GPS position of the station, optional (used on the network map)
createModal.timezoneHint: Used to timestamp this station's readings and reports
createModal.is24hHint: When checked, the opening/closing times above are ignored
createModal.closedWeekdaysHint: Check the days the station is closed all day. No day checked = open every day.
createModal.notesHint: Internal notes about this station, optional
createModal.tanksHint: Optional — you can also add tanks later from the station page

old.title: Potentially unreliable data
old.description: At least one tank at this station has not sent a measurement in over 45 minutes. The displayed stock values may not reflect the real state — do not rely on them until verified.

late.title: Delayed data
late.description: At least one tank at this station has not sent a measurement in over 15 minutes. The displayed values remain indicative.

tanksSection.title: Station tanks
tanksSection.empty: No tank registered for this station
tanksSection.hint: Volume, water, available space and measurement freshness for each tank

sales.title: What is this station's sales rhythm?
sales.subtitle: Volume per day and per product — 30 days
sales.empty: Not enough calculable sales data over the last 30 days.

stock.title: Is the station's stock being replenished?
stock.subtitle: Vertical rises are deliveries; gaps are missing measurements
stock.empty: Not enough real measurements over the last 30 days to plot a curve.

stationDetail.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate this station? Its history stays available.

unavailable.title: Not available for your role
unavailable.description: This section is reserved for roles holding the matching permissions.

pumpsTab.title: Equipment of type “pump”
pumpsTab.note: Prototype pumps show nozzles and totalizer indexes: Zylo Liquid does not model those counters (see gap matrix) — this table lists the station's actual “pump” equipment records.

staffTab.title: Station staff
staffTab.note: Network members with a role assigned to this station (RBAC station-scoped assignment) — displayed role names are the real role names in the system. Organization-scoped roles (e.g. Owner) are not station assignments and do not appear here.
staffTab.empty: No member assigned to this station.

complianceTab.note: Station regulatory documents and declarations — statuses computed by the backend from the actual expiry date; types shown as raw text. Management (add, renew, produce) stays on the network Regulatory screen.

atgTab.note: Holykell probes mapped on the station's active tanks. Value, unit and status = last reported state from the telemetry registry (measured truth); the mapping (tank/measurement, validity dates) is the declared truth.
atgTab.noTanks: No active tank on this station.
atgTab.empty: No probe mapped on the active tanks.

administrationTab.mapNoPosition: No GPS position recorded for this station.

operations.productsHint: Explicit station ↔ product association — never inferred from an existing tank.

suppliers.empty: No supplier linked to this station.
